programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marker = min((v for v in counts if v != 0), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - (max(dr for dr, dc in shape) + 1) + 1):
        for c in range(w - (max(dc for dr, dc in shape) + 1) + 1):
            cells = [(r + dr, c + dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[i][j] == 0 for i, j in cells):
                for i, j in cells:
                    out[i][j] = marker
    return out
'''

            cells = [(r + dr, c + dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[i][j] == 0 for i, j in cells):
                for i, j in cells:

    return out
